# Flip Match (Lật Thẻ)

> Flip Match is a free memory card matching game (also called concentration, pairs or "memory"): flip two cards, find matching pairs. Play instantly in any web browser with no download or sign-up, or install the iOS and Android app. Play solo, against the computer, with up to 4 people on one device, or online with friends in a private room joined by a 6-digit code or link. No ads, no in-app purchases, suitable for all ages (4+). Made by the Cozy Pi studio.

## Key facts

- Price: free. No ads. No in-app purchases.
- Platforms: web browser (desktop and mobile), iOS app, Android app.
- Play online in the browser: https://flipmatch.cozypi.com/en/
- Modes: solo; vs computer (5 difficulty levels); local multiplayer on one device (up to 4 players); online rooms with friends (up to 4 players, 6-digit room code or invite link, no account needed); a 60-level campaign.
- Boards: 12 sizes, from 4 cards to 88 cards.
- Optional rules (each with 4 levels): timer, lives, peek, shuffle, special cards.
- 48 card themes: animals, food, flags, numbers and more, drawn as 3D emoji.
- More than 100 achievements; personal records for every board size.
- 15 languages: English, Vietnamese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Italian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Indonesian, Thai.
- Light and dark mode. Works offline for solo, vs-computer and same-device games.
- Online chat is limited to 12 preset quick phrases (no free text), safe for kids.
- Age rating: 4+ / Everyone.
- Optional sign-in with Apple or Google only to sync progress and join the leaderboard.
